description: Keyword metrics and research for App Store / Google Play search terms: popularity (5–100), difficulty (0–100), result count and the #1 result's estimated daily downloads. include adds related terms with metrics, the store's autocomplete and the current top 10 apps; app adds that app's rank and metadata relevance per term (the core of an ASO keyword audit). Unmeasured terms are measured live (a few per call) or come back pending. Cost: 1 per keyword; 5 per seed with include=related or suggestions credits.

app.description: Any app identifier (as in `{app}`); adds `app.rank` and `app.relevance` per term.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (storefront), e.g. us, gb, de. Default: us.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

include.description: related (~10 related terms with metrics), suggestions (store autocomplete), top_apps (current top 10). related/suggestions cost 5 credits per term

terms.description: Search terms, 1–25 (at most 5 with include related or suggestions)

wait.description: Block up to ~25 s for a refresh (default). false = answer immediately from cache with a job id.

name: keyword_research
title: Keyword Research
